en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who eats a Quince upon the empty stomach would make good his water and improve the child birth’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one eats quince before breakfast his seed becomes fine and his child well-formed.’”
